title: fix(mail): validate mailboxIds keys as RFC 3977 group names in email/set
description: create_one_email uses mailboxIds keys directly as newsgroup names in the Newsgroups: header. A key containing a comma (e.g. 'alt.test,From: injected') splits into spurious groups after strip_crlf removes newlines. Fix: reject mailboxIds keys that fail validate_group_name.
